context.issue_text:
Cross-instance-same-tenant attachment-content denial is timing-distinguishable from cross-tenant/never-issued denial via an unconditional artifact-blob read.

Full detail in docs/issues/ISS-0785.yaml.

Summary: Letflow.Repository.Attachments.get_content/2 (lib/letflow/repository/attachments.ex ~362-445) performs an unconditional Repo.get on the artifact blob whenever the attachment metadata row exists, regardless of instance_id. The instance_id check in fetch_scoped_attachment_content/4 (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex ~1156) happens AFTER get_content/2 returns. This makes cross-instance-same-tenant denials cost 2 Repo round-trips (second reads the full artifact byte blob) vs 1 for cross-tenant/never-issued. This is a timing side-channel that distinguishes two classes of denial that REQ-211/212 explicitly intends to be indistinguishable.

Suggested fix (from ISS-0785.yaml): Reorder get_content/2's lookup so instance_id check happens before the artifact blob read, OR thread instance_id into get_content/2 so it can fold the cross-instance case into the same single-round-trip nil path.

result.summary:
ROOT CAUSE (confirmed from actual source)

CALL CHAIN TRACED:

1. handle_get_attachment_content/3 (instances.ex ~1137) calls fetch_scoped_attachment_content/3 (instances.ex ~1175).

2. fetch_scoped_attachment_content/3 (instances.ex ~1175-1192) immediately calls Attachments.get_content(raw_attachment_id, opts) with NO instance_id argument. The instance_id check only happens AFTER get_content/2 returns:

   case Attachments.get_content(raw_attachment_id, opts) do
     {:ok, %Attachment{instance_id: ^instance_id} = attachment, artifact} -> {:ok, attachment, artifact}
     {:ok, %Attachment{}, _artifact} -> {:error, :not_found}  # cross-instance: blob already read, discarded here
     ...
   end

3. get_content/2 (attachments.ex ~417-424) has no instance_id parameter:

   def get_content(id, opts) when is_list(opts) do
     prefix = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :prefix)
     with {:ok, attachment} <- get(id, opts),              # 1st Repo.get: Attachment row
          :ok <- check_scan_status_clean(attachment) do
       case Repo.get(Artifact, attachment.content_hash, prefix: prefix) do  # 2nd Repo.get: FULL blob read
         %Artifact{} = artifact -> {:ok, attachment, artifact}
         nil -> {:error, :content_missing}
       end
     end
   end

TIMING GAP (exact):

- Cross-tenant / never-issued: get(id, opts) at attachments.ex ~418 returns {:error, :not_found}; with short-circuits; NO blob read. Cost: 1 Repo round-trip.

- Cross-instance-same-tenant: get(id, opts) at attachments.ex ~418 returns {:ok, attachment} (row exists, belongs to different instance in same tenant); check_scan_status_clean passes; Repo.get(Artifact, attachment.content_hash, ...) at attachments.ex ~421 fires and reads the full binary content column. get_content/2 returns {:ok, attachment, artifact}. Then fetch_scoped_attachment_content/3 at instances.ex ~1180 checks attachment.instance_id, finds mismatch, returns {:error, :not_found} -- discarding the blob. Cost: 2 Repo round-trips (second reads full binary blob).

This is a real, measurable timing distinguisher. The same gap affects both call sites of fetch_scoped_attachment_content/3 in instances.ex (handle_get_attachment_content/3 at ~1137 and handle_get_attachment_link_content/3 at ~1302).

CALLER INVENTORY: Attachments.get_content/2 has exactly ONE production caller: instances.ex via fetch_scoped_attachment_content/3. EntityAttachments.get_content/2 (entity_attachments.ex) is a different module/function, unaffected.

RECOMMENDED FIX: Option A -- Thread instance_id into get_content/2

Change signature to get_content(id, instance_id, opts) and add a check_instance_match/2 guard in the with chain BEFORE the blob read:

  with {:ok, attachment} <- get(id, opts),
       :ok <- check_instance_match(attachment, instance_id),   # NEW: short-circuits here for wrong-instance
       :ok <- check_scan_status_clean(attachment) do
    case Repo.get(Artifact, ...) do ...                         # only fires for correct-instance case

  defp check_instance_match(%Attachment{instance_id: iid}, iid), do: :ok
  defp check_instance_match(%Attachment{}, _iid), do: {:error, :not_found}

Ordering: instance check -> scan check -> blob read. The cross-instance path returns {:error, :not_found} after 1 round-trip (same as cross-tenant), eliminating the timing gap.

The caller in instances.ex ~1176 is updated to pass instance_id. Its {:ok, %Attachment{}, _artifact} branch (currently the cross-instance discard) becomes structurally unreachable and should be removed.

Option B (caller checks instance via Attachments.get/2 first): adds a 3rd Repo round-trip to the happy path, introduces TOCTOU window. Not recommended.

Option C (add instance_id WHERE clause in get/2): more invasive; get/2 has other callers (DELETE path) that don't need instance scoping at that level. Not recommended without broader impact analysis.

WHAT THE FIX MUST NOT BREAK:

1. REQ-211/212 cross-tenant isolation: opts[:prefix] remains the sole tenant scope guard; the new instance_id check is an additional filter within the already-tenant-scoped lookup, never a replacement.

2. Response-shape indistinguishability (AC5/AC6/INV-5): all denied branches must still return {:error, :not_found} from fetch_scoped_attachment_content/3. check_instance_match/2 returns {:error, :not_found} (not a new atom) to preserve this.

3. scan_status gate (ISS-0399): instance check before scan check before blob read is correct and safe. A wrong-instance attachment must not trigger the scan check (no point).

4. Existing test coverage for REQ-211/212: all tests exercising get_content/2 directly need the new instance_id argument. TEST-DESIGNER must add timing-indistinguishability tests confirming cross-instance-same-tenant path now costs 1 round-trip, not 2.

5. INV-RT-1: fix stays entirely in lib/letflow/repository/attachments.ex plus call-site update in lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex. No Repo.* call added to the router layer.
